name: Moy
text: Moy, and the prefix Moy-, give the sound of the Irish word Mag, which means plain. The anglicized form marks both imagined and real place-names: Moytura and Moytirra carry it, and so does Moynalty.

attributes.attribute: phonetic anglicization of Irish Mag, plain
prefix in place-names such as Moytura and Moynalty

okr.objective: Documents Moy as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Moy is the phonetic anglicization of Irish Mag.
The form appears in both imaginary and actual place-names.
